title: AtlasVector security and compliance guide
text: AtlasVector encrypts data in transit and at rest. Administrative actions are recorded in an exportable audit log. The guide states that EU data residency is available for enterprise deployments.

title: Independent AtlasVector deployment audit
text: The audit verified encryption and audit-log export. It found that production indexes were stored only in the US region during the assessment, so EU data residency was not yet available.

title: Northstar regulated-search benchmark
text: On the representative corpus, AtlasVector achieved recall at ten of 0.91 and p95 query latency of 182 milliseconds. Both results passed the pilot thresholds of 0.88 recall and 250 milliseconds.

title: AtlasVector operations review
text: Incremental indexing recovered automatically after a worker restart. Bulk reindexing required manual throttling, and the reviewer recommends a capacity run before production adoption.

title: Northstar regulated-data deployment policy
text: Production search services containing regulated documents require verified regional residency, encryption, exportable administrative audit logs, and a documented recovery test.

title: AtlasVector launch benchmark
text: The launch benchmark reported p95 latency below 100 milliseconds on a small synthetic corpus.

title: Northstar travel and expense policy
text: Employees must submit travel receipts within thirty days.
